<style>

/* hide title block but keep browser tab title */
.quarto-title-block { display: none !important; }

/* Remove Quarto’s layout padding */
main#quarto-document-content,
.page-columns,
.content,
.column-page {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Let the page scroll by at least 1px so mobile chrome can collapse */
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
  /* allow scrolling! */
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* Use a flex column layout for the whole page */
#quarto-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  /* svh respects visible toolbars; +1px enables the micro-scroll */
  min-height: calc(100svh + 1px);
}

/* Main fills remaining space; keep internals tidy without locking the page */
main#quarto-document-content {
  flex: 1 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden; /* ok here; not on html/body */
}

/* Fullscreen wrapper should be flexible, not hard-locked to dvh */
.fullscreen-carousel {
  /* was: height: 100dvh; */
  min-height: 100svh;
  width: 100vw;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Carousel container */
#gallery-carousel {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Carousel items */
#gallery-carousel .carousel-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  transition: opacity 1.5s ease-in-out;
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}
#gallery-carousel .carousel-item.active {
  opacity: 1;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Image sizing (slightly looser on mobile to avoid footer overlap) */
#gallery-carousel img {
  max-width: 68vw;
  max-height: 68svh;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
  border: none;
  box-shadow: none;
  outline: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Footer: sits at the bottom naturally; protect for notches */
footer {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}

/* Mobile tweaks */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  #gallery-carousel img {
    max-width: 80vw;
    max-height: 80svh;
    object-fit: contain;
  }
}

</style>
